thread:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - Elevated 5xx and timeouts detected from model-serving runtime in prod (us-west-2). Severity: SEV2. Metric link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/98321

jess: acked. I'm on it. tagging @mike and @tara.

mike: seeing a sharp spike at 2024-06-14T08:12Z. 5xx rate ~12% across gateway, p95 latency ~1200ms (baseline 350ms). Heap OOMs and segfaults in model-runner processes.

tara: good call. is it single model or many?

mike: initial filter shows 90% of errors tied to model id "redwood-open-alpha-v2" on machines in nodepool-gpu-2. logs show repeated 'malloc: out of memory' then segfault.

raj: copying log tail from node gpu-2-17:
```
[2024-06-14T08:12:10Z] model-runner[pid:4321] ERROR: Allocation failed for KV cache size 2048MB
[2024-06-14T08:12:10Z] model-runner[pid:4321] FATAL: segfault (signal 11) at 0x7f8a3c9
[2024-06-14T08:12:11Z] kubelet: container restarted: exitCode=139
```

jess: ok immediate mitigations: 1) divert traffic off problematic model variant, 2) scale up fallback pool with quantized variant, 3) restart affected pods with temporary higher mem limits. I'll start 1 and 3 now.

tara: agree. also enable prefix caching off for that model to reduce KV pressure. config key: `model.cache.enabled=false` for that route.

mike: I'm spinning up a canary route pointing to `redwood-open-alpha-v2-quant-small` and throttling to 5% traffic. command: 
```bash
# route canary 5% to small quant variant
redwoodctl route update --model redwood-open-alpha-v2 --canary-target redwood-open-alpha-v2-quant-small --percent 5 --region us-west-2
```

raj: restarting the 3 pods on gpu-2-17..19 with higher mem limit now:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set resources deploy/model-runner-gpu --limits=memory=32Gi --requests=memory=24Gi --selector=node=gpu-2-17
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-runner-gpu -l node=gpu-2-17
```

jess: restarted two pods, third in progress. will monitor. also turned on eviction-safety flag for that nodepool to avoid immediate re-eviction.

mike: after canary (5%) reduction observed: 5xx down from 12% -> 3.8% in canary segment. p95 down to ~420ms. Good sign.

tara: I'm toggling prefix cache off for that model and lowering KV cache size per config: `model.kvcache.max_entries=512` via config service.

raj: pods back up. one had core dump. i've uploaded core to s3: s3://redwood-dumps/cores/gpu-2-18/core-4321.tar.gz

mike: checking core - stack points to attention kernel in quantized path. tag: `quant-attn-kernel`. Also seeing memory growth pattern on long sequences.

jess: traffic now 30% on fallback quant-small, 70% normal but with routing to healthy nodes. overall 5xx across prod dropped to 2.1%. still elevated but improving.

oncall-ml: taking over live for next 2 hours. summary of actions so far: - canary route to quant-small 5% -> scaled to 30% - restarted 3 pods with increased mem - prefix cache disabled for model - eviction safety enabled on gpu-2 pool - core dump uploaded to S3.

mike: customer impact: approx 1100 unique requests failed in last 20 mins (~0.9% of total traffic). three customers reported visible errors; EU region highest hit. SLO alerts triggered for two teams (SLAs: 99.9%). Notified support with rollback guidance.

jess: posting rollback command to support thread: 
```bash
# rollback routing to previous stable model variant
redwoodctl route update --model redwood-open-alpha-v2 --target stable/redwood-open-alpha-v1 --percent 100 --region us-west-2
```

raj: temporary mitigation recommendation: pin traffic to quant-small for the model until kernel patch/rollback of runtime lands. prepare for image rollback if kernel patch not ready.

tara: assign follow-up: investigate quant-attn-kernel regression, run mem-repro harness, and add anti-eviction guard for long-seq workloads. I'll own eval harness.

oncall-ml: accepted handoff. next steps for me: 1) keep quant-small at 30% and monitor 15m window, 2) coordinate with runtime team to reproduce with our repro scripts, 3) open postmortem and link to ticket ENG-5732, 4) notify customers via status page update.

mike: 25 minutes in since initial alert: prod 5xx at 1.4%, p95 ~360ms. Looks stable.

jess: thanks team. switching channel to monitor-only. if errors spike >3% reopen.

oncall-ml: created ticket ENG-5732 with summary and attached core + logs + metrics. assigning to @raj and @tara for root cause. target RCA draft in 48h. tagging runtime and model infra.

tara: note for postmortem: evaluate if automatic downgrade to smaller KV cache should be part of routing policy for models with long-contexts.

jess: closing incident channel for active mitigation. plz update postmortem with timeline and customer notification copies. :white_check_mark:
